name: TakeOnTime Vendor
description: Comprehensive TakeOnTime campus dining ecosystem supporting all sectors (institutes & mess, tech parks & corporate, hospitals, industrial plants, hotels). Features multi-branch premises management, live rush-calibrated table & seat reservations with OTP check-ins, multi-staff role-based access control (owner, cook KDS, waiter floor terminal, express dispatcher), weekly & monthly meal subscription passes, and full vendor/customer/admin operations.
